name: Snowflake
one_liner: Cloud data platform; REST APIs (SQL API, resource-management REST APIs) per customer account.
auth_notes: Per-account endpoint. Key-pair JWT, OAuth token, or programmatic access token, all sent as Authorization: Bearer; optional X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type header.
access_notes: No vendor app review; credentials are issued inside each customer's own account. Free 30-day trial needs only an email; trial ends at 30 days or credit depletion, then suspended.
sandbox_or_test_env: 30-day free trial account (no payment info); AI features disabled until credit card added

mcp.notes: Snowflake-managed MCP server; Snowflake-Labs/mcp community-style repo is deprecated.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST (SQL API /api/v2/statements plus OpenAPI resource APIs) with standard Bearer tokens, but per-customer account hostnames, user key-pair/OAuth setup by admin, network policies, and SQL API statement limits.

disputes.why: Official trial page: email-only 30-day trial; no approval gate. Paid account needed after trial.
Official Snowflake-managed MCP server documented; Snowflake-Labs repo is deprecated in favour of it.
SQL API auth page lists OAuth, key-pair JWT and PAT, all Bearer.
REST APIs cover accounts, users, warehouses, tables, tasks, etc. with OpenAPI specs; count not verified.

auth.quote: Authorization: Bearer JWT where JWT is the token that you generated.

access.quote: all you need is a valid email address; no payment information or other qualifying information is required.

sandbox.quote: The trial continues for 30 days (from the sign-up date) or until you’ve depleted your free usage balance

api_surface.quote: These REST APIs are compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.

mcp.quote: The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts without needing to deploy separate infrastructure.
This project is deprecated and no longer maintained. Please migrate to the official Snowflake MCP Server.

buildability.quote: The endpoint for the SQL API (/api/v2/statements) is protected by the network policies
not all resources in the API currently provide 100% coverage of their equivalent SQL commands
